propositions: Repository-wide documentation and comment survey against operator standards dated 2026-08-20 must establish baseline defects across external documentation, internal records, developer comments, and shipped help before remediation begins.

Documentation ownership policy, prose validation tools, comment hygiene expansion, and generated-artifact ownership registry must be established to prevent future defects and guide contributor compliance.

Factual corrections for client README, operation certificates, import guidance, CLI options, adoption templates, configuration guidance, identity setup, Jira operator setup, and authentication documentation must restore accuracy against implemented behavior.
Internal architecture, event schema, concurrency, ADR lifecycle, and runbook documentation must be rewritten from current implementation state and decision records to serve future developers.

Durable records including ADRs, design notes, research archives, experiments, and migration registries must be classified and preserved with provenance, frozen evidence, and maintained procedures separated from completed work and chronology.

Generator-local descriptor protocols must replace central artifact registry to expose sources, outputs, update paths, verification methods, and lifecycle without duplicating owner-local logic or requiring source-text inference.
